jobs.title: Script Supervisor
jobs.description:
* Review dubbing scripts for accuracy, consistency, continuity, formatting, timing, and overall recording readiness.
* Identify proc e sses. Resolve script discrepancies, continuity issues, missing information, inconsistencies, and other potential production problems before and during recording.
* Support recording sessions by maintaining accurate scripts and tracking script changes, pickups, revisions, and other adjustments made during production.
* Collaborate closely with dubbing directors, recording engineers, production staff, adapters, and other members of the localization team to address script\-related questions and issues.
* Maintain continuity of terminology, character names, pronunciations, story elements, and other creative details throughout episodes, features, or multi\-part projects.
* Ensure approved script revisions are accurately documented, communicated, and incorporated into production materials.
* Track script status and workflow milestones to help ensure materials are prepared and delivered according to production schedules.
* Coordinate script\-related deliverables across multiple projects while balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Review and compare source materials, translations, adaptations, reference materials, and production documentation as necessary to identify inconsistencies or potential issues.
* Maintain organized and accurate records of script versions, revisions, session changes, and final materials.
* Escalate significant creative, technical, scheduling, or quality concerns to the appropriate production or studio leadership.
* Help troubleshoot script and workflow issues that arise during recording while minimizing disruption to studio operations.
* Support pickups, retakes, and revisions by ensuring the appropriate script information and production history are readily available.
* Follow established client specifications, Iyuno workflows, security requirements, and quality standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of script preparation, QC, documentation, and recording\-support
* Perform other related duties as assigned based on production and business needs.
**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in dubbing, localization, post\-production, television, film, animation, audio production, script supervision, script coordination, or a closely related environment.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing or working extensively with scripts in a production setting.
* Strong understanding of dialogue, story continuity, character consistency, and the relationship between written scripts and recorded performance.
* Excellent written English skills, including grammar, spelling, punctuation, and proofreading.
* Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies that may affect recording quality or downstream production.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced production environment where priorities and schedules may change quickly.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both creative and technical teams.
* Sound judgment and the ability to resolve routine production issues independently while recognizing when escalation is appropriate .
* Comfortable working with digital production tools, shared documentation, spreadsheets, databases, and workflow\-management systems.
* Ability to handle confidential and pre\-release entertainment content with discretion and in accordance with strict content\-security requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in a professional dubbing or localization studio.
* Familiarity with dubbing adaptation and recording workflows.
* Experience supporting ADR, voice recording, animation, or other dialogue\-intensive production environments.
* Knowledge of timecode, recording scripts, pickups, retakes, and common post\-production terminology.
* Experience working with episodic television, feature films, animation, or other high\-volume entertainment content.
* Experience working with major entertainment or streaming clients and client\-specific localization requirements.
* Additional language profic iency i s a plus.
Salary $80,000\-$85,000

jobs.title: Audio Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software EngineerAbout the Job** 

We are seeking a highly motivated individual for a software development position focused on developing audio applications and plug\-ins for sound designers, musicians and audio production professionals. No two days are alike at iZotope/Boris FX and we thrive on it \- we transform our passion for audio into innovations in the way we create and listen to sound.

The team is fully remote and highly collaborative, has a passion for high\-quality code and in learning how to continually improve our craft. Qualified applicants should have in\-depth knowledge and demonstrable experience designing, developing and debugging software in C/C\+\+ for Mac and Windows. The ideal candidate would have a passion for music and audio technology \- though prior experience with audio plugins or the audio industry is not required.

Responsibilities will include:

* Work closely with a cross\-functional agile team consisting of Product Management, UX Designers, Sound Designers, Research and QA to define and realize product requirements
* Design, prototype, develop and deliver new audio products in C/C\+\+
* Maintain and upgrade existing audio products written in C/C\+\+
* Contribute to improvements, refactoring and re\-architecture of the application and UI framework, to maintain state\-of\-the art foundation for our products

Required Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of experience developing efficient, reusable and reliable C/C\+\+ code for production\-quality products
* Excellent English language verbal and written communication skills
* BS in Computer Science or equivalent combination of technical education and work experience
* Exceptional engineering skills, designs for quality, expert problem solver, strong analytical skills
* Solid understanding of test\-driven development, design patterns, software frameworks, performance optimization, system architecture
* Self\-directed, detail\-oriented, able to learn new technologies and work independently
* Experience as a technical leader and/or coach to other software developers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Team player and able to work collaboratively with peer Software Engineers, QA, Product Managers, UX Designers, Sound Designers

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with cross\-platform development using Microsoft Visual Studio, Apple Xcode, Git
* Familiarity with continuous integration environment and tools
* Experience with Agile or Scrum software development methodologies
* Experience using and/or developing audio plugin SDKs a plus
* Working knowledge or exposure to DSP and audio signal processing algorithms a plus
* Working knowledge or exposure to Python \& Python tools for scientific computing and machine learning
* Experience developing and deploying services, web applications or cloud solutions using AWS

**About iZotope** 

iZotope makes audio products and technologies that are used around the world. We have

a wide range of customers, from the millions of consumers who enjoy our audio

enhancement to GRAMMY\-winning producers using our pro products to the corporations

who license our technology for use in their own products. We are a growing team of

highly motivated people who are constantly looking to innovate and improve the way we

create and listen to audio.

iZotope is part of Boris FX \- a multinational virtual software company focused on the world\-wide Media and Entertainment industry.

Pay: $51\.39 \- $61\.89 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote
